summary: community.docker made all doc fragments, module utils and plugin utils private, so they can break at any time.
questions: Can I reuse community.docker module_utils in my collection?

answer_card.title: community.docker utils are private
answer_card.answer_md: From Ansible 13, all community.docker doc fragments, module utils and plugin utils are **private** and may change or break at any time, even in bugfix releases.
